scope.repository_context: A small Allegro-oriented form/search and WebSocket proof of concept, with a separate Swing HTTP client and API test artifacts.
limitations: No HR application behavior is evidenced.
Vue search uses embedded fixtures, not a backend or persistent data source.
The Node service is a WebSocket broadcast relay; it does not implement the HTTP POST endpoint referenced by the separate Swing client and API artifacts.
API test scenarios and OpenAPI descriptions are expectations/specification, not proof of server functionality or persistence.

capabilities.name: Person Search and Payment Selection
capabilities.description: Find and select person/payment sample records in the browser mock.
capabilities.implementation_status: Implemented as a client-side prototype over hard-coded fixtures; not a production search service.

sub_capabilities.name: Fixture-Based Person Search and Selection
sub_capabilities.description: Search sample people by supported name and address criteria, display matches, and select a person and payment beneficiary.

capabilities.name: Allegro Form Data Handoff
capabilities.description: Transfer selected person/payment data or free text from the Vue mock through WebSocket to a separate Swing receiver.
capabilities.implementation_status: Prototype client/relay/receiver path is implemented; selection guards, durable delivery, and production integration are absent.

sub_capabilities.name: Publish Selected Data and Text
sub_capabilities.description: Send target/content WebSocket messages for selected form values and textarea changes.

sub_capabilities.name: Populate Desktop Form from Messages
sub_capabilities.description: Parse recognized message targets and map selected person/payment fields or text into the standalone Swing UI.

capabilities.name: Desktop Form Capture and Submission Demonstration
capabilities.description: Capture person, address, payment, gender, and text values in a separate Swing form and demonstrate an outbound JSON POST.
capabilities.implementation_status: Form/model/client behavior exists, but the referenced HTTP endpoint is not implemented in this repository; end-to-end submission is unverified.

sub_capabilities.name: Form Entry and Model Binding
sub_capabilities.description: Render desktop form controls and synchronize text and gender input with model state.

sub_capabilities.name: HTTP JSON Submission Client
sub_capabilities.description: Serialize the model field map and POST it to the referenced localhost /post endpoint.

sub_capabilities.name: Submission Feedback and Form Reset
sub_capabilities.description: Propagate response-derived text to the presenter and clear/reset visible controls after a normal response event.

capabilities.name: WebSocket Message Relay
capabilities.description: Accept WebSocket connections and broadcast received UTF-8 text frames to connected clients.
capabilities.implementation_status: Implemented as a small in-memory relay on port 1337; it does not interpret or validate business payloads.

sub_capabilities.name: Connection and Broadcast Handling
sub_capabilities.description: Maintain connected clients and fan out incoming text messages.

sub_capabilities.name: Relay Runtime Dependency Setup
sub_capabilities.description: Declare the Node WebSocket package required by the relay.

capabilities.name: Prototype Application Startup and Build Support
capabilities.description: Provide entry points, client shell, and build/dependency configuration for the separate prototype applications.
capabilities.implementation_status: Partially represented by source launch/configuration artifacts; configurations do not establish one integrated production deployment.

sub_capabilities.name: Client Application Bootstrap and Shell
sub_capabilities.description: Start the separate Swing MVC-style prototype and bootstrap/render the Vue client shell.

sub_capabilities.name: Build and Dependency Configuration
sub_capabilities.description: Declare Java/Vue dependencies, compiler settings, and frontend transpilation configuration.

sub_capabilities.name: Placeholder Scaffolding
sub_capabilities.description: Empty placeholder type; no business or technical behavior is implemented by this file.

capabilities.name: POST API Contract and Test Verification
capabilities.description: Describe a POST contract and provide a Cucumber/RestAssured harness that expresses and checks response expectations against a separately configured endpoint.
capabilities.implementation_status: Specification and test client are present. Successful POST, echo/update behavior, and persistence are expectations only; no API server is implemented here.

sub_capabilities.name: POST Contract Specification
sub_capabilities.description: Describe the request and response shape for POST /post.

sub_capabilities.name: Scenario Expectations
sub_capabilities.description: Specify full, partial, empty, and update-shaped test cases and their expected responses; does not implement endpoint rules.

sub_capabilities.name: Scenario Execution and HTTP Assertions
sub_capabilities.description: Prepare requests, call the configured endpoint, and assert the returned status/body/content type.

sub_capabilities.name: Scenario State, Test Fixtures, and Runner Setup
sub_capabilities.description: Maintain per-scenario request/response context, sample data, Cucumber settings, and isolated test-project dependencies.

file_mappings.rationale: Composition root for the independent com.poc Swing form, model, presenter, and event emitter.
Standalone Swing WebSocket receiver parses target/content messages and maps recognized values into form controls.
Generic typed holder used to keep the form's field state in the model; contains no independent business rules.
Synchronous in-process event dispatch carries the model's response text to the presenter; it is not a distributed event broker.
Defines the callback interface used by the model/presenter feedback event flow.
Serializes a string-valued map and sends HTTP POST JSON to localhost:8080/post; server implementation is absent.
Enumerates the person, address, payment, gender, and text fields bound by the form and included in the model submission.
Collects the enum-keyed model values, converts them to strings, invokes the HTTP adapter, and emits response-derived feedback.
The class is empty; mapping records its presence without attributing an implemented capability.
Binds Swing text/radio controls to model state and invokes the submit action; also handles response display/reset.
Renders the separate desktop form's personal, address, payment, gender, text, and submit controls.
Hosts the WebSocket server on port 1337, tracks active peers, and broadcasts UTF-8 frames without interpreting business content.
Provides the Vue shell/header and renders the Search component; no search logic is implemented in this file.
Bootstraps the Vue root component and mounts the browser application.
Implements local OR-based search over hard-coded records, person/payment selection, and initiation of the WebSocket handoff; no backend search is present.
Declares root Java compiler settings and WebSocket/Tyrus/JSON-P dependencies; it is build configuration, not business behavior.
Documents a POST /post request/response contract but does not implement or host the endpoint.
Declares the WebSocket package dependency used by the Node relay; contains no relay behavior itself.
Declares Vue client packages and build/lint scripts, supporting the browser prototype rather than a business service.
Configures Vue CLI's Babel preset for the browser client.
Configures JUnit/Cucumber feature discovery and test report execution; it does not run an API server.
Builds scenario requests and asserts endpoint responses; its assertions describe external endpoint expectations, not server implementation.
Wraps RestAssured JSON POST calls for test scenarios against a configured endpoint.

file_mappings.capability_name: Scenario State, Test Fixtures, and Runner Setup
file_mappings.rationale: Configures feature discovery, step glue, report plugins, and ignored-tag filtering for the test harness.

file_mappings.capability_name: Scenario State, Test Fixtures, and Runner Setup
file_mappings.rationale: Defines the isolated test project's Java 17, Cucumber, JUnit, RestAssured, and reporting dependencies.
